items.title: Privacy Screen removed (v2.12.5)
items.note: Deleted the privacy blackout tool completely: service, tool card, boot auto-start and manifest entry. It was the cause of the frozen black screen and the blocked taps. Broken Screen prank now self-clears after 10 seconds so no overlay can trap you.

items.title: Guardian Alert Network live (v2.5.0)
items.note: Wrong password now captures the phone location and alerts your chosen number by SMS with a live Google Maps link — and when online, DMs the intruder selfie to you on WhatsApp automatically. Gunshot playback rebuilt on AudioTrack so it fires every time.

items.title: Guardian 2.0 shipped (v2.4.0)
items.note: Gunshot + shattered-screen jumpscare, SMS intruder alerts, and TRUE both-sides call recording via Shizuku. Research verdict: live in-call voice morphing needs root — Empire Calls (in-app voice-FX calls with friends) is the honest path, coming next.

items.title: Call Recorder shipped (v2.3.0)
items.note: Record phone calls with auto-save on hangup. Open the Calls section and tap Call Recorder. The speaker turns on automatically so both sides of the call are captured — the same technique pro recorders use on modern Android.

items.title: v2.2.0 Vision Edition shipped
items.note: Security Patrol (3-hourly spyware/sideload/keylogger auditing with alerts), Voice Studio with real robot-voice DSP, and the AR Camera Compass with spirit level. Enable auto-patrol in App Scanner, and try Voice Studio from the Calls section.

items.title: Quran Audio has arrived
items.note: The full Quran is now inside the Empire. Open the Quran section, tap 'Download complete Quran' once while you have data — then listen offline forever, even in deep sleep. Recitations by Mishary Rashid Alafasy and Muhammad Ayyoob.

items.title: Two-tier updates are live
items.note: From now on: MAJOR upgrades (new APK) arrive through Check Updates. MINOR upgrades (news, tips, small fixes) arrive right here — no reinstall, just refresh. The website shows both.

headline: 🔒 Privacy Screen removed: your phone can never be blacked out again
body: The Privacy Screen tool has been removed. Its sensor could latch on and paint a black layer over everything, which made the phone look dead. Eye Care is untouched and typing still works. Broken Screen now clears itself after 10 seconds.
